question: The position of how many letters will remain unchanged if each of the letters in the word 'LAMENT' is arranged in alphabetical order?
solution:
** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d26a4107141c8988092be3a6f971de10fd85269bdcee88518465cc72c114f65.png] **

Given word: LAMENT 

Arranging it alphabetically it follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b15d15aa836a4c7c42bfb6cbbcc3edb274e0abdea5e4d6dfb001ac7ffb6b6031.png]

Hence, the correct answer is "**Two**".
